title: Refresh the evaluator child preview after a retained submission is recorded
outcome: After successful retained-write recovery, the child session preview agrees with the recorded receipt and repaired delegation result without restarting the evaluator.
acceptance: A behavioral fixture terminalizes an evaluator with an Unconfirmed submission, replays it to durably Recorded and reads the child session through its public view.
The child preview then uses the compact receipt summary rather than the prior host unconfirmed message, while the child runtime status remains terminal and diagnostic prose is retained.
Unknown, refused and failed-ACK replays preserve their original uncertainty and do not publish a falsely confirmed child preview; focused tests pass.
